response.sql: SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY (AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0)) IS NULL, ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Media types are taken from Track.MediaTypeId, so only media types that have at least one track appear.
The overall average is the mean UnitPrice across all tracks (each track counted once, not weighted by sales). A zero overall average gives a NULL ratio, which sorts last.
Ties in the ratio have no specified order.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every media type in the MediaType table, including those with no tracks. Those get a NULL average and ratio and sort last.
alternatives.sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM MediaType m LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY (AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0)) IS NULL, ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10
